channel.title: The Wilson Times - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Wilson Times (wilsontimes.com)

item.title: New library books: Large print books added at library
item.description: Wilson County Public Library adds new adult, large print, YA, Spanish and children's books, including titles by Michael J. Fox, Colleen Hoover and Erin Hunter; place holds by phone or on the library website.

item.title: ‘With many hands, it becomes small work’: Waymakers feeds those in need
item.description: Waymakers of North Carolina’s monthly plate giveaway has grown from 300 to up to 1,500 meals, serving food to those in need of a hot meal with help from volunteers and Jackson Chapel First Missionary Baptist Church.

item.title: Bond set at $1M for man accused in attempted robbery and kidnapping
item.description: A Wilson man is charged with attempted common law robbery and second-degree kidnapping after a woman reported a suspect tried to force her from her car; he remains jailed with no bond.

item.title: Church news: Local congregations plan weekly services
item.description: Wilson-area churches announce Feb. 14-28 services, special programs and Black History Month events.

item.title: NCHSAA Basketball Glance, Feb. 13, 2026
item.description: Feb. 13, 2026 NCHSAA basketball glance: updated boys and girls standings, rankings, scores and upcoming games for Big East, Eastern Plains, Eastern Carolina AC and Three Rivers conferences.

item.title: Wilson County Emergency Communications earns international accreditation
item.description: Wilson County 911 earned international accreditation as an Emergency Medical/Fire Dispatch Center of Excellence.

item.title: One woman’s refusal
item.description: A Supreme Court case over Fed governor Lisa Cook’s refusal to resign could determine whether presidents can fire Jerome Powell, threatening Federal Reserve independence and the dollar’s stability.

item.title: Ronald Reagan’s imaginary enemy
item.description: A new Reagan biopic borrows the controversial fictional-narrator device pioneered in Edmund Morris’ “Dutch,” raising questions about credit, criticism and cinematic Reagan biographies.

item.title: Why NC is outperforming the nation’s soft landing
item.description: As the U.S. economy cools, North Carolina posts faster job growth, lower unemployment and big reserves, bolstered by a decade of tax reforms that critics once said would backfire.

item.title: Warbirds hosting national anthem tryouts
item.description: Wilson Warbirds will hold tryouts Feb. 21 for singers and instrumentalists of all ages to perform the national anthem at home games during the team's inaugural season.
